pool.titulo: The Definitive Proof That GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption Share The Same Universe
pool.resumen: Here are the seven easter eggs in GTA 6 that prove Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto take place in the same universe.
pool.contenido:
From action movies to popular memes, there are dozens and dozens of Easter eggs and references to wider pop culture in GTA 6. But Rockstar has also slipped in more than a few nods to some of the studio’s previous games within Leonida. There’s a Manhunt-themed tattoo, for example, and a ludicrously convoluted secret that has already been unearthed involving a portal back to the days of Vice City. But one series is showing up more than others: Red Dead Redemption.
We’re still working our way through finding all of them, as is the rest of the internet, but so far we’ve found seven secrets that relate to the developer’s beloved Western games. From hats and guns to road names and license plates, here are seven Red Dead Easter eggs in GTA 6.
Valentine Drive If you’re looking for hidden details about Red Dead, the Western-themed Frontier Mini Golf course is a natural place to start. While none of the holes directly tell the tale of Red Dead Revolver, Red Dead Redemption, or its prequel—aside from squinting at hole four and seeing a snowy train wreck as a tangential nod to RDR2’s prologue—there are still things to find.
We’ll get on to who can be seen roaming it in a moment, but before you even set foot inside, an Easter egg can be found. That’s because the attraction itself is located on Valentine Drive, a reference to the first major town you explore in Chapter 1 of Red Dead Redemption 2’s story. This is the location where Arthur famously drinks a few too many beers, has a bit of a dance, and looks for his friend, Lenny. Sadly, alcohol doesn’t seem to be served at this Mini Golf, although there’s nothing stopping you from bringing your own six-pack in.
Tiny Arthur Morgan Once you’re on the course, though, a little friend with a familiar face riding on his back may well walk up to you. A small chihuahua with a cowboy toy, dressed in remarkably similar clothing to what Red Dead Redemption 2 protagonist Arthur Morgan wore in many of the game’s trailers. Feel free to give the little guy a pet, too, and his gun-toting rider will look like he’s giving it a little “yeehaw”. Adorable.
Arthur’s Hat Perhaps more life-sized Arthur Morgan Easter eggs are more your thing, though. Well, get yourself over to Port Gellhorn to get your hands on, and head in, one such thing. Follow the trail of signs and balloons to find a resident looking to get rid of any old tat. Hidden amongst it all, though, is a real treasure. No, not the cow-patterned Hawaiian shirt, but something that will make fans of Red Dead Redemption 2’s hearts flutter a little: a genuine cowboy hat. Not just any cowboy, either, but Arthur himself. The dark brown colour, complete with twisted rope around the rim, is unmistakable, and is now Jason or Lucia’s to wear whenever they like. An absolute bargain at $35, too.
Duke Arms As if we needed any further proof that the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption stories take place in the same universe, the Duke Arms Company cements this. At any of Leonida’s Ammu-Nation stores, you can find weapons made by the same gun company that produced the Duke 1853 Navy Revolver in Red Dead Online. On the packaging found inside GTA 6’s gun stores, you can also spot 1853 written out in Roman numerals (MDCCCLIII) on the boxes. It just can’t be a coincidence.
Flaco Hern á ndez and Blackwater “The Cowboy’s Prayer is To Die Young” is a Wild West-set novel of which you can read a few pages in GTA 6. There are a few fun little details hidden within. First, a mention of Blackwater, the port city from Red Dead Redemption and its prequel, where John Marston chooses to build his ranch near to. But there’s also a familiar name to those who chose to fully engage with RDR2’s side activities.
Flaco Hernández was an infamous outlaw who you can meet during the 2018 game’s “The Noblest of Men, and a Woman” stranger mission. At the end of that story, you knock on his cabin by Cairn Lake and defeat him in a duel. The book in GTA 6 recounts all of these details, confirming that the events of Rockstar’s Western games are canon in Grand Theft Auto lore. There are many copies of the book to be found around Leonida, but I spotted one at the Grayson Motel towards the north of the map in Lummox County.
New Austin License Plates More locations from Red Dead here, as you may have spotted some vehicles roaming around Leonida that don’t sport license plates belonging to the “Goodtime State”. In fact, some of them hail from New Austin, the sandy state in Red Dead Redemption where the likes of Armadillo, Tumbleweed, and Thieves’ Landing can be found. Unfortunately, you can’t add one of these to your own car at a GTA 6 mod shop, but you can always jack someone else’s ride if you want to pretend you’re from the cowboy-adjacent state.
Rad Dad’s Redemption Tour And finally, more of a fun wink to the camera than a full-on Easter egg, there’s a band playing live shows in Leonida that must be a fan of Rockstar’s western games. Get yourself over to the Three Sheets liquor store in the starting area of Key Lento to take a look at a poster for the Rad Dads’ show. They’re heading out on a redemption tour. Rad Dads Redemption. Red Dead Redemption. Get it? There’s not much more to say about this one than that, really.
And those are the Red Dead secrets that we’ve found so far in GTA 6. Did we miss any? Let us know in the comments.

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

pool.titulo: Every Team We'll See in Avengers: Doomsday
pool.resumen: How many super teams will be in Avengers: Doomsday? A lot...
pool.contenido:
With the new “final” Avengers: Doomsday trailer as well as the recent reveal from Marvel of who exactly makes up Sam Wilson’s Avengers team in the film , some of the more casual fans out there might think, “OK, you have a Captain America, an Asgardian, a bug guy, and a couple of others. That’s our new Avengers.” To which the less than casual, more, shall we say, ardent fans will scream, “BRUSH UP ON YOUR MCU, MAN!” Because you know what? Doomsday will definitely be featuring more than just a simple, single team of Earth’s Mightiest Heroes.
Yeah, we’ve got X-Men, we’ve got Fantastic Four, and we’ve got a whole lot more too. So let’s take a look at all the super teams that will show up in the new movie when it hits (that we know of so far, anyway)...
(Note: We of course don’t know every character who’ll pop up in Doomsday, or how the events of the film will play out, so there could be – and likely will be – some flux to these team line-ups as the story unfolds. Exciting!)
The Avengers Captain America (Sam Wilson) Falcon (Joaquin Torres) Ant-Man (Scott Lang) Thor Shang-Chi The MCU version of the Avengers haven’t actually had that many adventures when you think about it, at least not onscreen. The original team was formed in 2012’s titular team-up movie, and then they returned in Age of Ultron three years later. But by the end of that film, a new line-up was formed – with Vision, Scarlet Witch, Falcon and War Machine joining while Iron Man, Thor, Hulk and Hawkeye left (leaving just Captain America and Black Widow as the sole remaining OGs). And then the whole Sokovia Accords thing happened two movies after that, which sent all the heroes into disarray. By the time Avengers: Endgame rolled around, it kinda seemed like, well, everyone was an Avenger?
And that mindset could be continuing into Doomsday. Based on the end of Thunderbolts, the Avengers name is getting thrown around by a couple of different groups now. In that film’s post-credits scene , the new Sam Wilson-led Avengers team is mentioned… by the Thunderbolts, who are now also calling themselves the Avengers. “But we are the Avengers,” says Yelena Belova. “The government said so. How does Sam Wilson not understand that?” Bucky Barnes responds, “Well, he does have the shield.” Indeed, it’s as if the idea behind the Sokovia Accords is still lurking here – do the Avengers work for the government or are they an independent operation? Sounds like we’ll have both in Doomsday.
This lineup is also interesting in that it’s got a couple of members from the first two incarnations of the team in Thor (who apparently is back from outer space, where we last saw him in Thor: Love and Thunder) and Sam. And while Scott Lang has worked with the Avengers plenty, he was nevery officially a member before this – although his inclusion here makes a lot of sense considering his history with Sam. As for Joaquin Torres, he’s a newbie, having been Sam’s partner in Captain America: Brave New World, as is Shang-Chi (though we did see the latter hero catching up with some familiar faces in his debut film’s post-credits , namely Wong, Captain Marvel, and Bruce Banner).
The New Avengers Black Widow (Yelena Belova) Bucky Barnes U.S. Agent Red Guardian Ghost Sentry/Bob If you saw Thunderbolts, you know that this team came about as a result of Julia Louis-Dreyfus’s Valentina Allegra de Fontaine recruiting various super-powered folks over the course of the past few Marvel Phases, only to then try to have them all kill each other at the start of that film. Instead, they teamed up and saved New York City by the time of the closing credits, and so de Fontaine seized the opportunity to grab the spotlight and announced that they’re the New Avengers. She also owns Avengers Tower now, so, you know, convenient.
But also revealed in the film’s post-credits scene is that the New Avengers are losing the public relations war that is going on between them and Sam’s Avengers. And Sam has even filed for copyright of the name “Avengers.” Meanwhile, Red Guardian proposes that the team call themselves the New Avengerz, with a “z”...
This is a team of mostly “punch and shoot” type heroes – only Ghost and Sentry have truly formidable powers. They’ll definitely need some help against Doctor Doom.
The Fantastic Four Mister Fantastic Invisible Woman The Thing The Human Torch H.E.R.B.I.E. Newcomers to the big screen – well, this incarnation of them anyway – the Fantastic Four just showed up in the summer of 2025, and now we’re all expected to be excited to see them meet up with our favorite heroes from 18 years worth of MCU and another 18 years of X-Men movies? Just not happening, sorry.
That said, Reed Richards and the gang will apparently be uniquely placed to inform the Avengers and X-Men about who it is that they’re up against, since the trailers for Doomsday have made it clear that the FF and Doom have a history of some kind in the universe that they hail from. This was left open-ended in The Fantastic Four: First Steps. Additionally, that film ended with Doom visiting with Reed and Sue’s baby son Franklin , presumably with a plan to kidnap the child and utilize the child’s reality-shaping powers to his own end. We see in the “final” Doomsday trailer that the FF visit Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter in the past, so could they be there to warn the couple that their own son might be in danger too?
The X-Men Professor X Cyclops Beast Nightcrawler Gambit Magneto (Brotherhood of Mutants) Mystique (Brotherhood of Mutants) You just can’t keep a good X-Men team down! Well, until you finally reboot them once and for all, which is currently happening with the Jake Schreier-directed X-Men movie that’s already cast new actors to play the likes of Professor X, Cyclops, Jean Grey, Storm, and more. pool.titulo: Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers Join Fortnite This Week
pool.resumen: Scott Pilgrim takes on the world of Fortnite later this week, with the battle royale's next crossover. Check out this first look.
pool.contenido:
Scott Pilgrim takes on the world of Fortnite later this week, with the battle royale's next crossover.
Character skins for Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers will become available via the Shop for an as-yet undisclosed amount of V-Bucks. To be clear, these are the graphic novel versions of the characters — so no Michael Cera in Fortnite, yet.
Epic Games announced the collaboration today via a teaser trailer showing off both character skins in action (Ramona has multiple hair style options, I can see), riffing on the story's plot of Scott defeating a league of evil ex-partners.
Other Fortnite shenanigans we've learned of today: a Puss in Boots collaboration is next on the docket (and yes, Puss will be a pet-like Sidekick) before the current mini-season is done. Speaking of which, Fortnite's big year-end live event is currently slated for December 5, which is also when the game will hold its next Community Day.
Hop into Fortnite then for a smattering of free cosmetics, watch on Twitch for a free golden Jonesy skin, and if you've picked up at least 800 V-Bucks at some point this season you'll get the long-teased pirate Hope skin. Exactly what's set to happen during the event remains to be seen, but the stage is set for Fortnite's uber big bad Geno to finally get his come-uppance (again), while the mysterious Captain X will reveal his true identity after recently crashing a real-life awards show. Here's hoping it's not Mr. Beast.
How's Fortnite doing right now? The launch of GTA 6 has naturally had some impact on its daily active player count, though Alinea Analytics noted the battle royale had recovered well following Rockstar's big launch last week. The same cannot be said for Call of Duty , with active HQ users down 40% since GTA 6's launch. It seems fair to suggest that COD's audience is more aligned with GTA's, but Fortnite has also reaped the rewards of its current mini-season allowing players to win a fortnight of free access to the game's Shop — something many players have been grinding for, despite low odds .
What's next for Fortnite? While Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney spends his time on X / Twitter discussing AI and various other subjects, his team will launch the game's Chapter 8 incarnation following that December 8 in-game event. As of yet, nothing major has leaked for what's in store.

pool.titulo: Dead by Daylight: Terrifier’s New Killer is No Laughing Matter
pool.resumen:
Hope you’re not afraid of clowns. Putting the laughter in slaughter, The Terrifier steps into Dead by Daylight as the hit horror multiplayer’s latest Killer. A serial murderer fueled by a sick sense of humor, Art the Clown met his end at the hands of Sienna Shaw. Rising from the dead with a thirst for […]
The post Dead by Daylight: Terrifier’s New Killer is No Laughing Matter appeared first on XBOX Wire .
pool.contenido:
Hope you’re not afraid of clowns. Putting the laughter in slaughter, The Terrifier steps into Dead by Daylight as the hit horror multiplayer’s latest Killer.
A serial murderer fueled by a sick sense of humor, Art the Clown met his end at the hands of Sienna Shaw. Rising from the dead with a thirst for vengeance, Art’s dogged pursuit of his favorite final girl has led the two straight into the claws of The Entity and Dead by Daylight’s endless cycle of Trials.
Known for his unpredictable nature and ecstatic violence, The Terrifier makes a clear fit for Dead by Daylight ‘s fiendish roster. But with that chaos comes the challenge of making humor and horror blend together into a compelling gameplay loop for Killers and Survivors alike.
Players beware – it’s all fun and games until the clown pulls out a gun.
A Work of Art
Joining the likes of Jason Voorhees and Freddy Krueger, Art the Clown is the latest addition to Dead by Daylight ‘s unmatched repertoire of horror legends. While past slashers were the killers that many grew up fearing, Art the Clown represents a more modern (and extreme) horror icon for a new generation of fans.
“I think the thing that attracts people to Art is how fun he is,” reflects Dave Richard, Dead by Daylight ‘s Creative Director. “He’s an absolute menace taking his time to torture and tease his victims before going all in for a big kill. We really wanted to lean into that fantasy when designing his kit.”
With his Power, Bag of Toys, Art reaches into his trash bag for a random selection of weapons including a flail, a flamethrower, a firearm, a beer bottle full of acid, and even his signature bike horn. Each successful hit with a toy builds its deadliness, eventually letting Art down injured Survivors and execute them with murderous glee.
With a unique Mini-Mori for each weapon alongside two additional finishers, Art has a mind-blowing total of seven executions: a new record for the series! This clown’s creativity really knows no bounds.
Art’s kit is as unpredictable as his film counterpart’s antics, making you adapt on the fly to whichever tools you pull from his bag. The gun is great for shooting targets at a distance but is a bit shaky when aiming in close quarters. No choice is a bad choice, however, and in a skilled players hand, every tool can spell death for the most daring Survivors.
Clowning on Survivors
Never speaking a word in “The Terrifier” films, Art instead relies on big gestures and huge facial expressions, a signature part of his character. Principal Killer Designer Janick Neveu knew that incorporating Art’s overly emotive nature would be key to bringing him to life in-game.
“We knew right from the start that we wanted to have an emote system in place for Art. The idea of hooking a Survivor and then immediately pointing and laughing at them was too good to resist.”
A first for any Killer in the series, Art’s emotes range from a mocking laugh and an eerie wave to straight up flipping the bird at his opponents. More than just a means of self-expression, Art’s emotes play an essential part in his kit as well.
“Players can emote at any time as Art, but emoting at a Survivor after downing or hooking them will increase the deadliness of all his weapons,” explains Neveu. “This really puts them into a position where if they want to play optimally, they really have to get into the character’s mindset and act like Art.”
This extends to The Terrifier’s unique character Perks as well. Laughingstock, Kill Spree, and Funny Business all incentivize players to take big swings as they go over-the-top to get their last laughs. When you step into Art’s oversized shoes, you’d better be ready to act like a clown.
Delightfully devious, Art the Clown will have you going all out in every Trial. When your best jokes don’t land in the Trial, remember that sometimes the easiest way to crack someone up is to give their head a good beating with a hefty table leg.
Dead by Daylight: Terrifier is out on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One today.

pool.titulo: Ethan Hawke (56 años), protagonista de Gattaca y Predestination, sobre el placer: "La verdadera felicidad es cumplir con nuestras responsabilidades"
pool.resumen:
Ethan Hawke estrena este viernes Oro sin ley (The Weight), el debut como director del veterano montador Padraic McKinley , un thriller de supervivencia en plena Gran Depresión. Hawke es Samuel Murphy, un preso al que el capataz de un campo de trabajo ( Russell Crowe ) ofrece la libertad si cruza los bosques de Oregón con oro de contrabando, su única forma de recuperar a su hija antes de que la den en adopción. La cosa se complica, obvio.
Por el estreno ha concedido una entrevista a La Vanguardia donde habla de sus cuatro hijos y deja una idea que me ha parecido muy interesante: viene a decir que confundimos el placer con la felicidad , y que esta se encuentra más bien en cumplir con lo que nos toca y en hacer bien el trabajo, algo que los hijos ponen a tu alcance. Habla de ser padre, pero creo que es algo que podamos aplicar a muchas facetas de la vida. Y también os digo que retrata a muchos de sus personajes de ciencia ficción y fantasía, un terreno que el bueno de Hawke pisa desde que debutó de crío en Exploradores (1985) de la mano del director Joe Dante .

pool.contenido: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a towering technological achievement. It is an open-world game made up of criss-crossing emergent systems that make it feel like life is unfolding all around you, whether you’re there to see it or not. A few days into its lifespan, players are already finding a host of quirks and bugs that are turning the hyperrealistic GTA 6 into a slapstick comedy show.

pool.titulo: Cyberpunk 2 Is Still a Ways Out, but CD Projekt Red Says Its RPGs Will Come Out Faster in the Future
pool.resumen: We are still two years out from The Witcher 4, but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.
pool.contenido:
We are still two years out from The Witcher 4 , but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.
In a November 24 earnings call , CD Projekt Red VP of Strategy & Investor Relations Karolina Gnaś said the team is "making good progress with Cyberpunk 2, we are happy with where we are, but it's still too early to give a specific date and plan on when we will move onto full production." Although she couldn't provide a clear date when we'll hear more about the game, she did add that the studio plans to have around 200 developers by the end of 2026 and 320 by the end of next year.
It is admittedly a bit early to expect any kind of information about the Cyberpunk sequel, but it has been simmering in the background since at least 2022 , and it sounds like CD Projekt Red wants to speed up development of its massive RPGs. In its consolidated earnings report , CD Projekt Red admitted that most of its games "normally take 3 to 6 years to produce," mostly due to working on one game at a time. But that strategy has since changed.
In that same report, the company said, "At the moment, the CD Projekt Red studio is working in parallel on several productions (also in collaboration with external development teams) and supporting products, which is expected to translate into shorter intervals between the releases of subsequent titles in the future." Whether or not that new timeline will affect Cyberpunk 2 is the question.
But even if that faster development timeline is in effect for Cyberpunk 2, it's likely we'll still have to wait a while to actually see it in the wild. In an earnings report last year, when Cyberpunk 2 entered pre-production, CD Projekt CEO Michał Nowakowski suggested that CDPR's games take four or five years to move from pre-production to release, which would put the game somewhere in 2030 or 2031. And given that the game still hasn't entered full production, it isn't likely we're going to see some sort of rapid release after the Witcher 4 in 2028.
We're probably going to be waiting a little while longer for Cyberpunk 2, but it's already sounding like the game is taking shape. Just last month, associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a lot of the developers working on Cyberpunk 2 are former modders. Sasko went on to claim that "the modding community is really keeping [Cyberpunk 2077] alive," so hopefully that energy translates to Cyberpunk 2 – whenever it comes out.

CD Projekt Red has signed a marketing deal with PlayStation for The Witcher 4 .
The studio confirmed the deal in its latest earnings report, which may also suggest that marketing is about to ramp up. Additionally, CD Projekt Red noted that this partnership will "cover the presence" of its games on PlayStation and PlayStation Plus, which likely means older titles like The Witcher 3 or Cyberpunk 2077 may make their way to the subscription service in the future.
“Just today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign,” said Piotr Nielubowicz, chief financial officer at CDPR. "This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years.”
It wouldn't be surprising if PlayStation uses this agreement to make The Witcher 3 available through PlayStation Plus when the game's new expansion releases in 2027. This deal may also mean that The Witcher 4 has a big presence in a future State of Play stream, though no hard specifics were revealed by CD Projekt Red. Currently, the game is due out in 2028 , so new trailers and gameplay seem likely next year.
The decision also signals an end of an era, to a degree. CD Projekt Red has had a strong relationship with Xbox since The Witcher 3. The game was prominently featured during Xbox's E3 showcases, and that continued with Cyberpunk 2077, even resulting in a special edition Xbox One X console themed after the game. Given PlayStation has a larger user base than Xbox this generation, it makes sense why CDPR may be interested in working with them.
Marketing deals can be extremely effective when done right. In the case of GTA 6, a lot of people bought PlayStation 5s instead of an Xbox, since Rockstar and Sony marketed the console as the "best place to play" the game. This led to the game being the biggest launch in PlayStation's history , with 39 million people playing it on PS5. 70% of people who bought a new PS5 during the last week also booted up GTA 6 as their first game.

pool.titulo: Over Half of GTA 6 Watch Time Came From Viewers Under 25 Years Old
pool.resumen: The bulk of fans watching streams of GTA 6 are under 25 years old, according to recent stats compiled by StreamsCharts.
pool.contenido:
The bulk of fans watching streams of GTA 6 are under 25 years old, according to recent stats compiled by StreamsCharts.
After 13 long years, GTA 6 is finally out in the wild. Rockstar’s highly-anticipated release has already broken numerous records, one of the most impressive being that it became the single most popular game ever on both Twitch and Kick just 26 hours after its global release.
Now that it’s had a little time to breathe, more data is rolling in, including information about who’s watching streamers play the game. StreamsCharts , a data analytics company that studies games-focused streaming platforms, discovered that most viewers of GTA 6 broadcasts tend to trend under the age of 25.
According to Streamlabs’ stats, 30.8% of viewers in GTA 6 streams are 20 - 24 years old, making up the bulk of those watching the game across Kick, Twitch, and YouTube. (Painfully, StreamsCharts pointed out that these players were in elementary school when GTA 5 came out.) 16.8% of these viewers are 17 - 19, with 8.5% accounting for viewers 16 or under. The second-largest age range watching GTA 6 streams are viewers aged 25 - 29. 11.6% of viewers are 30 - 34, and the numbers keep dropping from there.
StreamsCharts also found that an overwhelming majority of these viewers are single men, accounting for 83.8% of the gender divide. That’s not to say that gals aren’t also watching streamers play Rockstar’s latest; 14% of viewers are female, and if you’ve been on social media lately, you’ve probably seen a fair few female players showing off their outfits for Jason and Lucia or the viral conversation about how it’s, oddly, comparable to a crime-focused version of The Sims.
Perhaps unsurprisingly, the United States makes up the bulk of GTA 6 viewership. Brazil isn’t far behind, coming in at 12.4% of the game’s total audience; Spain and Germany follow at 6.9% and 6.8%, respectively.
Certain games have also experienced a drop in viewership following GTA 6’s release. StreamsCharts found that GTA 5 had the sharpest drop-off on Twitch, followed by the platform’s Just Chatting category and World of Warcraft.
The GTA hype train is in full swing, and it’s making big bucks for Rockstar. The company reportedly made a staggering $3.79 billion from the game in just 24 hours, making it the single biggest entertainment launch in history. Internet provider Comcast even revealed that it experienced its highest-traffic day ever as players downloaded the game to their consoles, and PlayStation confirmed that GTA 6 was its biggest game launch in the company’s history.

pool.titulo: Kevin Feige and the Russo Brothers are Planning a Special Tribute to Patrick Stewart as Avengers: Doomsday Release Approaches
pool.resumen: Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige has revealed that he and the Russo brothers are creating a tribute to honor the late great Patrick Stewart in light of his final performance in Avengers: Doomsday.
pool.contenido:
Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige has revealed that he and the Russo brothers are creating a tribute to honor the late great Patrick Stewart in light of his final performance in Avengers: Doomsday.
Sir Patrick Stewart died at the age of 86 on October 28, 2026. The prolific actor’s death followed a brief battle with Alzheimer's and Lewy Body Dementia, prompting a period of mourning from both fans and fellow collaborators, the latter of whom shared fond memories from their time working with the Star Trek and X-Men alum on social media.
Speaking with Entertainment Weekly ahead of Avengers: Doomsday’s December release, Kevin Feige revealed that he and the Russo brothers are working on creating a tribute to Stewart, given his many years playing Charles Xavier in the X-Men films.
“We’re long done filming that movie [Doomsday], and he did an amazing job for us,” Feige told the outlet. “We’re looking now at how we can put something together that honors and respects our friend.”
In that same interview, Joseph Russo reflected on Stewart’s role in the upcoming film, revealing that the actor shared a particularly moving scene with his fellow thespian and real-life best friend, Ian McKellan. (I’m growing misty-eyed as I type this; McKellan shared a touching statement about his late friend shortly after the news broke, saying he “wore his heart on his sleeve, which made him a man to rely on, to admire and in my case, love.")
“In a lot of ways, Xavier’s the conscience in the movie,” Joseph Russo revealed. “He has a lovely scene with Ian McKellen, who’s his best friend, in the film. It’s a very emotional scene about forgiveness, and I think very resonant in the wake of his passing.”
Anthony Russo went on to share an anecdote about his time working with Stewart on the set of Doomsday, saying the actor did his best to put on a good show in spite of his failing health.
“It was clear that he was struggling with his health, and he worked so hard to deliver a performance and a presence — for us as directors, for his other actors, for the crew,” Anthony said. “You could see it wasn’t just the effort of a regular actor showing up and delivering that kind of presence and performance and experience for others, collaboration. It was someone who was really being challenged in a very deep way on a health level, showing up and doing that. For him to have muscled through and delivered the performance that he did in that movie, and the experience that he delivered for all of us as collaborators, it made it intensely emotional.”
Avengers: Doomsday marks Patrick Stewart’s final film performance. The knighted actor was best known for playing Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Charles Xavier in the X-Men films of the 2010s, but also lent his talents to numerous memorable voiceover roles, such as Emperor Uriel Septim VII in the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion and Lord Yupa in Studio Ghibli’s Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind .
Avengers: Doomsday releases in theaters on December 18, 2026. For more news about this forthcoming superhero flick, check out what we learned from its “final” trailer , and peep the parallels fans discovered between the latest Doctor Doom poster and another early promotional Iron Man poster.

pool.titulo: Walmart Now Lets Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop for You During Black Friday
pool.contenido:
Ready or not, the world of agentic AI is descending upon us. From Meta’s Muse to OpenAI’s Dots , a number of artificial intelligence companies have released digital “agents” that have capabilities beyond just answering questions in a chat window. These AI assistants can actually do things for you, either in the cloud or directly on your computer. One of those things is shopping.
Some retailers are putting up barriers to make sure AI bots can’t shop on their websites. Walmart is going the other way and embracing the AI-bot-shopping future. Just in time for Black Friday , the mega-retailer has set up Agent Profiles and the Walmart Agent Gateway , which allow digital agents to shop on behalf of customers, within certain limitations. Muse intigration with your Walmart account is now available.
With Agent Profiles, Walmart’s system knows your Muse agent is shopping on your behalf, and won’t mistake its actions for yours. The profile also lets you track which items your agent has purchased separately from those you've bought yourself.
Muse won’t have access to your shopping history or other personal information known to Walmart. You can set additional guardrails around your Muse agent, like giving it a spending limit, and requiring it to ask for manual approval before completing purchases. You can also delete the agent’s profile at any time.
If you want to try it out, you can do so in the Muse app. First you’ll be asked to sign into your Walmart account, and then brought back to Muse, where you can ask it to compare products or find deals on items you’re interested in buying. It can add items to your cart and use your saved payment information to check out, if you let it.
I tried the Walmart integration this morning by asking Muse to add an item to my cart. Instead of using the official Walmart Agent Gateway and creating an Agent Profile, it opened a virtual browser and added the item to a guest cart on Walmart's site, set for pickup at a store I didn’t recognize.
I then asked Muse if it had official Walmart integration, and it confirmed that it did. Only then did it offer me the new sign-in option. So you may need to specifically ask for it if you want to try it yourself.
On the other hand, if you want to do it old-school and peruse Walmart's Black Friday 2026 sale personally and without an AI agent, I don't blame you one bit.

pool.titulo: GTA 6 Gets Officially Licensed Trading Cards Based on In-Game Collectibles
pool.resumen: Rockstar is teaming up with Panini America to bring the hunt for GTA 6 trading cards to life.
pool.contenido:
The hunt for GTA 6 trading cards is leaving the virtual confines of Leonida — Rockstar is teaming up with Panini America to bring the in-game collectibles to life.
The officially licensed GTA 6: Sports Trading Card Collection is based on Panini’s standard sports card system, featuring rare-numbered cards and team color parallels. The GTA collection adds Vice City-specific Silver, Pink, Teal, and Light Blue parallels to the standard slate of Legend Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
The collectible company has revealed images of several cards planned for the collaboration, which is set to launch this December.
The Panini Group is an Italian-based collectible company that’s become quite the household name for sports card fans. Panini America is the official collectible partner for leagues like the WNBA, NASCAR, and FIFA, just to name a few.
GTA 6 cards will be released in four-pack boxes, each of which, on average, come with two Rookies, one Retro, one Illustrated, and four Special Silvers. There’s no word on pricing, but hobby boxes currently listed on Panini’s site start at $30 and go up to over $700.
Panini’s card images, shown above, feature a collection of fictional athletes from Vice City’s sports teams. Not all of the featured athletes are entirely fake — for instance, Tyreek Hill, ex-wide receiver for the Miami Dolphins, serves as the voice and likeness for the Vice City Manatees’ Maleek Rivers.
GTA 6 features a total of 480 trading cards across 16 individual sets, and we don't know exactly how many Panini is planning to turn into real cardboard. The sports-focused collectible company is less likely to adapt the collectible cards featuring other GTA 6 characters like Mandy and Vicki , but social media users can hope.

Asus ROG Flow Z13 Review by Chris Coke
The Asus ROG Flow Z13 is a fantastic 2-in-1 laptop-tablet for a particular kind of user, those who want that versatility with the best performance possible for productivity and gaming in this form factor – talk about multifaceted. pool.titulo: Rings of Power Renewed by Amazon for Season 4
pool.resumen: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 wraps up later tonight, but the show has already been renewed for Season 4 at Prime Video.
pool.contenido:
The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 wraps up later tonight, but the show has already been renewed for Season 4 at Prime Video.
Amazon MGM has renewed Rings of Power just as the show has wrapped up its third season, according to a report from Variety . The new season will continue the show's exploration of Middle-earth's second age, and will begin filming in spring 2027, though no release date has been announced yet.
While the show has been divisive for Tolkien fans, Amazon MGM's head of global television, Peter Friedlander, tells Variety that, "The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has become a defining series for Prime Video." He also says that after the finale of Season 3 delivered "the landmark moment fans have been waiting for," the studio looks forward to "bringing fans even deeper into the rich world of Tolkien's Second Age."
Thus far, the third season seems to be an improvement. Here at IGN, we gave the last three episodes of the show a 7 out of 10, with reviewer Jim Vejvoda saying, "The Rings of Power loses some forward momentum this week with two very talky episodes where several characters are literally waiting around for something to happen." However, the first half of the season was much stronger, with Jim giving the first four episodes an 8 , saying "The Rings of Power Season 3, Episodes 1-4 prove a welcome return to Middle-earth, allowing the series to get back on track after two seasons of wandering."
However, as the show nears the war that ends the Second Age of Middle-earth, it's going to be interesting to see where the showrunners take Rings of Power next season. There is a good chunk of time between the forging of the One Ring and the War of the Last Alliance that kicked off the Third Age, but no matter where they go with it, it'll likely involve the expanding influence of Sauron. We might even get another time jump.
It'll also be interesting to see if Prime Video takes the same approach to the show's release as it did with Season 3, releasing the episodes in blocks of three, likely to lure in new subscribers during Black Friday. pool.titulo: Wizards of the Coast Sues Website That Prints Fake Magic: The Gathering Cards, Alleging Counterfeiting Operation
pool.resumen: For as much as Magic: The Gathering has grown in popularity over the last several years, the market for proxies and counterfeits has also grown. And now, Wizards of the Coast is suing PrintMTG, alleging a counterfeiting ring for the trading card game.
pool.contenido:
For as much as Magic: The Gathering has grown in popularity over the last several years, the market for proxies and counterfeits has also grown. And now, Wizards of the Coast is suing PrintMTG, alleging a counterfeiting ring for the trading card game.
Wizards of the Coast filed the lawsuit (via Aftermath ) in its home state of Washington, alleging PrintMTG "operate as a complex and sophisticated network (...) engaged in trademark infringement, counterfeiting and criminal copyright infringement on a grand scale." Wizards seeks $28.65 million in damages.
For the most part, PrintMTG was a destination for people to print proxies, or essentially fake Magic cards that could stand in for real ones, for either playtesting or trying before you buy the actual card. And, thanks to the Reserved list, there are plenty of cards that cost thousands of dollars for a legitimate copy, so it's easy to see why going to a website and spending $0.75 on a proxy version instead was a popular choice.
In its complaint, Wizards of the Coast seems to acknowledge the purpose that proxies serve, saying "an honest proxy is a stand-in for a real card that makes no claim to authenticity by appearance or otherwise. Though proxies are prohibited in all sanctioned Magic events, Wizards recognizes that private and noncommercial proxying is a vehicle players can use to further engage with the game, not to undermine it." But, it seems PrintMTG proxies were a bit too realistic.
Later on in the complaint, Wizards of the Coast describes what it sees as a legitimate proxy, which "include writing the name of a card in marker on a basic land card or on a blank card printed for this purpose, using one genuine card to represent another or sliding a slip of notebook paper into a card sleeve." PrintMTG and other proxy-printing websites like it, will instead print Magic's art on card stock, for a price.
Wizards of the Coast alleges that PrintMTG's proxies "directly harm Wizards by displacing sales of genuine cards" and damages "retail partners who sell those cards." But even beyond that, the company alleges that these counterfeits were "creating instability and uncertainty in the very secondary markets third-party retailers rely on as a revenue center."
There's a whole Reddit community that's sprung up, /r/RealOrNotTCG , where people post pictures of Magic cards to try and figure out if they're, well, real or not. However, PrintMTG is just one of many services that print realistic Magic proxies. This is a market that's been around for years, and it seems like Wizards of the Coast is finally cracking down on it.
This lawsuit comes after Wizards of the Coast recently changed the way booster packs work, and ahead of Darkhold Destiny, its third Marvel set.

pool.titulo: Marvel Shows Off First Look at Kelsey Grammer's Beast in Avengers: Doomsday, and Fans Are Divided
pool.resumen: We’ve gotten our first look at Kelsey Grammer’s Beast as he will appear in Avengers: Doomsday, prompting fan confusion about why Marvel waited so long to reveal him and comparisons to his appearance at the end of The Marvels.
pool.contenido:
We’ve gotten our first look at Kelsey Grammer’s Beast as he will appear in Avengers: Doomsday, prompting fan confusion about why Marvel waited so long to reveal him and sparking comparisons to his appearance at the end of The Marvels.
This first look comes courtesy of Entertainment Weekly , which shared a high-resolution image of the furry blue mutant looking on with a mystified expression. The outlet’s report states that Kelsey Grammer was the second X-Men veteran to join the cast of Doomsday following the late great Patrick Stewart , making his first comeback appearance in a post-credits scene in The Marvels.
Apparently, Grammer’s scene was so well-received that Marvel decided to bring him back for their upcoming Avengers adventure. EW says that Grammer was told that he received “a lot of great response from that little cameo" — a sentiment that fans echoed in comments across social media.
First look at Kelsey Grammer as Beast in ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’.
(Source: https://t.co/K3CgumiaKe) https://t.co/a8YApJ0XhS
— DiscussingFilm (@DiscussingFilm) November 24, 2026
Most were puzzled as to why Marvel waited so long to show off the character, though some are at odds with his updated design in comparison to how he looked in The Marvels.
“Why were they so reluctant to show Beast fully, he actually doesn’t even look bad?” one confused commenter wrote.
“Looks way better than he did in The Marvels, why were they hiding him?” another asked.
“I like it, even though his appearance in The Marvels looked better,” yet another posited.
This film will mark the fourth time Grammer has portrayed Beast; he first took up the mantle in 2006's X-Men: The Last Stand , and reprised the role in X-Men: Days of Future Past in 2014. Almost a decade after this, he once again appeared as the character in 2023's The Marvels, and will once again play the part in Avengers: Doomsday in just a few weeks' time.
IGN got the chance to speak with Grammer after Days of Future Past, who told us he would "love" to do another X-Men movie. "I loved playing the Beast," he told us. "I called him the Blue Guy. It was just a joy for me to be involved in that franchise.
"Actually, when I heard they were making another one, it was Hugh [Jackman]. I was talking to him, and somebody said, 'Oh, you're going to be in the next one, mate.' And I said, 'Well, I didn't even know about it.'"
A slew of characters have already been confirmed to appear in Avengers: Doomsday. A recent trailer for the film showed off a few of the teams we can expect to throw down in the movie, which, of course, includes the X-Men. And a new poster also gave fans an up-close-and-personal look at Doctor Doom's metal mask, which some fans can't help but compare to another Marvel poster of Iron Man.

pool.titulo: Everything You Need to Know About HyperX’s Cloud III S and Cloud Alpha Air Headsets
pool.contenido:
The holidays are nearly here and we’re in the midst of some huge video game releases, so now is a great time to upgrade your gaming setup or help your loved one upgrade theirs. That includes your headset, which doesn’t always get the attention it deserves but can make a big difference to your gaming experience. HyperX remains one of the premiere options for headsets, headlined by the Cloud III S and Cloud Alpha Air.
The HyperX Cloud III S is a wireless headset that adds to the foundation laid by its predecessors in the popular Cloud III line. It’s able to pair with more devices thanks to having connectivity via 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, or an Instant Pair mode that’s compatible with certain OMEN laptops. It’s compatible with PC, Mac, PlayStation 4/5, Nintendo Switch, and mobile, so it covers most devices you’d want to use it with.
One of its defining features is its long battery life, which anyone can tell you is vitally important in a wireless headset. The convenience of going wireless doesn’t do a lot of good if you’re constantly having to recharge it. Luckily, the Cloud III S can reach up to 120 hours of gameplay when connected by 2.4GHz or up to a whopping 200 hours in Bluetooth mode on a single charge.
Wearing it for that long also means it needs to be comfortable, and the Cloud III S has you covered there too. It uses memory foam in the headband for extra padding, and its ear cushions are wrapped in soft leatherette to keep them fitting snugly and comfortably, even during long gaming sessions.
On the tech side, it has 53mm angled drivers to help it deliver clear sound and enhanced audio positioning, which helps you identify audio cues like footsteps. And it has a 10mm boom microphone with an LED mute indicator and built-in mesh filter for clear voice chats and calls.
There are also easy-to-use audio controls, letting you quickly and easily mute and unmute the mic, adjust volume levels, and switch between wireless modes. Plus, the boom mic is detachable and there are two built-in internal mics, so you have the flexibility of ditching the extended mic arm if you want. And it’s compatible with HyperX NGENUITY, which is a software that gives you control of lots of different customization options, like sound profiles, spatial audio, bass levels, and more.
Those are the main benefits of the Cloud III S, while the Cloud Alpha Air brings other strengths to the table. It’s an open-back headset, meaning its earcups are perforated to let sound pass out the back. This offers a totally different audio experience, with a much more natural, expansive soundstage.
Open-back headsets often have to sacrifice the bass, but the Cloud Alpha Air doesn’t have those same limitations. It uses HyperX Bass Tube to maintain the low end while still delivering the more life-like audio that open-back headsets are capable of, giving you the best of both worlds.
The open-back design helps with comfort too, since it’s more breathable and prevents buildup of heat and moisture. That significantly reduces ear fatigue, and when combined with its Ultrasuede materials and plush padding, it keeps them comfortable through extended use. All of that also helps with long-term durability, which is aided by the headset’s metal-reinforced headband and sliders.
It has ports for USB-C, USB-A, 3.5mm, and a USB dongle, allowing it to connect to PCs, Macs, PlayStation 4/5, and Xbox Series X|S. And like its cousin, it’s also compatible with NGENUITY, letting you get down to the nitty gritty details to find what works best for you.
If a new headset is on your holiday shopping list, then the HyperX Cloud III S and HyperX Cloud Alpha Air both make great options. It just comes down to personal preferences. pool.titulo: Real Life Strip Club Says It's Had 'Hundreds of Inquiries' From GTA 6 Fans, as Pornhub Traffic Plummets
pool.resumen: Strip clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6, and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it, hiring a choreographer to recreate the moves of the in-game dancers for its patrons. According to the club, it's in response to a wave of requests from visitors and people sliding into its DMs.
pool.contenido:
Strip clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6 , and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it, hiring a choreographer to recreate the moves of the in-game dancers for its patrons. According to the club, it's in response to a wave of requests from visitors and people sliding into its DMs.
"I’m fascinated with the attention to detail from Rockstar," said the head choreographer, Brooke Wilde. "I spent hours in Jack of Hearts and Delights Cabaret, mastering each performance to bring back to Spearmint, and now obsessed gamers can put down their controllers, get out of the bedroom, and experience their favourite virtual lap dances with the Spearmint Rhino girls in the real world. While the in-game strip clubs are addictive, nothing beats the real thing.”
While we can't be sure exactly how many people are reaching out to their local strip joints for IRL GTA-inspired bodily contact, you have to respect the hustle. It's also an interesting counterpoint given GTA 6's impact on another part of the adult entertainment industry, with Mashable reporting that Pornhub saw a 15.5% drop an hour after the game was released on November 19.
Spearmint Rhino's relationship with the series actually goes back to 2013 and GTA 5, when Rockstar used a play on the name of the clubs, Vanilla Rhino, and Rockstar has said that developers for GTA 6 visited strip clubs in Miami and Florida (where Spearmint Rhino has one of its venues) for research purposes.
In GTA 6, Jason and Lucia can both go to strip clubs either together as a couple or individually, and can opt-in for VIP lap dances. As explained in our GTA 6 sex and romance guide , you can throw money at dancers, and if you throw most of your money at one dancer they will remove some of their clothes.
“While gamers across the world immerse themselves in virtual worlds, demand for authentic real-world experiences has never been higher and we’ve had hundreds of inquiries from GTA 6 fans," explained the company president and COO, Kathy Vercher.
"Strip clubs are such an iconic feature in the franchise, and Spearmint Rhino is uniquely positioned to create a real-world experience for gamers. Thanks to the dedication of our Chief Choreographer, Brooke, we’ve been able to bring the in-game lap dance experience into our venues worldwide, with such accuracy that gamers are guaranteed to get a mindblowing real-life experience.”

pool.titulo: An Among Us player and his mom helped rescue a kidnapped girl who'd been missing for more than a year
pool.resumen: After connecting in the game, the teens began talking on Discord, which ultimately led to the discovery of her location.
pool.contenido:
A 17-year-old girl who had been missing for more than a year was rescued and returned home by the FBI after a friend she made while playing Among Us, and his mother, were able to track down her location and pass it along to law enforcement.
Landon Tresp told the BBC that he and the anonymous girl "kind of just clicked" when they started chatting online while playing Among Us. She eventually told Tresp she was a runaway who'd been held against her will for more than a year. After learning more, Tresp, 16, told his mother, Khristina, about the exchange; she was initially suspicious, but after speaking with the girl directly on Discord and reading reports of her disappearance, she took action, asking for a piece of mail or document with a full name on it, which the girl provided.
With that, Khristina began digging into tax and property records to find relevant addresses, which she then used to find photos on real estate sites. She showed the photos to the missing girl on Discord, who picked out the one where she was being held; with that information in hand, Khristina contacted the girl's mother on social media and spoke to her briefly on the telephone, and also received a call from the FBI asking if she could confirm that the girl was still alive.
"I said: 'I have; I video chatted with her, I've seen her'," Khristina told the BBC. "And she goes 'Oh my God, I cannot believe any of this'."
The kidnapped girl contacted Khristina the following morning, after her alleged captor, 39-year-old Adam Hunter Harmel, had left the house. In a conversation monitored by the FBI, she said she'd met Harmel on social media, where he'd pretended to be disabled and offered to pay her to help him get from Utah to Oregon. When he picked her up, however, he threw her phone into a river, then drove her to Oregon.
The girl told Khristina that she was kept in his basement and forced to sleep against the wall in his bed, while he kept a knife under his pillow to prevent escape. He gave her a mobile phone that wasn't able to make calls but could connect to wifi, which is how she was able to play online and eventually reach out for help.
While Harmel was out, law enforcement began monitoring his street and house; when the moment came, police had Khristina tell the victim that it was time to make her escape. She was able to leave the house safely and into the custody of state troopers, while Harmel was subsequently arrested and charged with transportation with intent to engage in criminal sexual activity.
A social media post by the Salt Lake City FBI confirmed the outcome, although the crucial role played by Landon and Khristina Tresp was omitted: It says only that "the FBI and the Rich County Sheriff’s Office have been actively investigating this case for more than a year and pursuing every lead received from across the US and in other countries."
A separate Department of Justice press release , however, acknowledges that "on Nov. 1, the FBI received a tip about the possible location of the minor victim and that the victim met Harmel on a social media application in May 2025."
Khristina and Landon have remained in daily contact with the girl they helped rescue, and they're trying to arrange an in-person meetup as well. "Sometimes we just sit on video chat, just so she knows she has someone that cares," Khristina said. "She was on video last night when I cooked dinner …it's nice to know that when she has a bad day or a bad moment, she can call me right away or call Landon right away. She's doing great for what she's gone through."

pool.titulo: Best unique weapons to grab early in GTA 6: Get yourself some silenced weapons without the price tag
pool.resumen: There are tons of unique and collectible weapons in GTA 6 but these are the best and easiest to snap up early in the game.
pool.contenido:
GTA 6 has a ton of unique weapon variants all with their own names and mods. They're all special custom builds of stock guns and weapons with unique skins, but some of them are way more worth the trouble to hunt down than others. You'll find some of them easily—every Ammu-Nation has a unique gun sitting out for you to buy. The best unique weapons are a little more hidden. There are treasure hunts and easter eggs and a whole lot that you'll grab by fighting your way through a gang hideout.
Best unique weapons to get early ⭐ Assassin Nipper .38 This is the easiest unique weapon to grab right at the start of the game and totally worth the boat ride to grab it. There isn't even any combat to get to it, like many of these other uniques. The Assassin Nipper comes with a suppressor attachment, which is a really expensive mod to buy early in the game. Pick it up as soon as you've got free range in Key Lento from an old shipwreck in the Permit Keys near the military base location .
Kingfishers Laird 350 Another great Chapter 1 snag is this sniper rifle at a Kingfisher hideout. The combat to get it is minimal (don't get between that tiger and its prey) so it's easy to pick up early. It's a bolt action that can't equip a silencer, so it isn't exactly a stealth tool, but it can help Jason pick off gangsters in a hideout before even going inside. It comes with a stock and a basic dot sight.
⭐ Scrapper VF5C A variant of the Vom Feur V5FC, found in Port Gellhorn at a Kolt gang hideout. It's up on the top floor of the motel by the La Cascara Motel safe , so you pretty much have to complete this illegal operation to grab it. I recommend coming up the south stairwell that's less guarded and hugging the outer walkways to get most of the way to the loot room by stealth. It's worth it though. The Scrapper is a silenced longarm SMG fairly early in the game with an extended mag and a flashy paint job.
Kolt & Associates 556 This Duke Carbine variant doesn't have a suppressor but it is quite high accuracy for a full auto assault rifle with a heavy stock and 7" pistol barrel mod. The Kolt 556 is easier to smash and grab than the Scrapper, though. You've got to fight in and out of the Kolt stash house, but it's a small joint so it's not too hard to get away clean. It's in a gun case on a kitchen table near the safe full of pills.
About unique weapons How unique weapons work Have their own unique names (like "Couch Potato Mustang .357") but are variants of other gun models in the game Have a gold gun icon on the map once you've gotten close enough to spot them, marked as "collectible weapon" Typically come with attachments, but always feature a paintjob or skin that stock weapons don't Automatically become part of your weapons locker as soon as you equip them Unique weapons cannot be customized by the player How to find all the unique weapons Ammu-Nation : Almost every gun store location has a unique collectible weapon for sale. These aren't always the best custom weapons out there though and they can be pricey. Pick these up if you're an achievement nut wanting to complete the full collection. Illegal operations :Most gang stash houses on your map will have a collectible weapon to find during the hit. They're usually near the safe for that location. GTA Base : This community interactive map crowdsources all sorts of collectibles in GTA 6. Not all of the collectible weapons are well-documented yet, and some have been incorrect reports, in my experience, but it's a good starting point for the exhaustive list.

pool.titulo: How to steal the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular in GTA 6
pool.resumen: Where to find the car wanted by Randy.
pool.contenido:
One of the cars Randy wants in GTA 6 is the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular—and don't let the name fool you, its a slick and speedy ride that'll you'll be tempted to keep for yourself.
But Randy doesn't know the locations of many of the cars on his wishlist, and can't point you to the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular: you just need to keep an eye out for it. Luckily, we spotted it ourselves, so just follow the simple steps below to find it.
Ocelot Bloodless Jugular location Head to Belville : It's a town in Leonard County, in the central eastern part of the map, a bit south of Lake Leonida and north of La Perle.
In the northern edge of Belville there's a little cluster of four homes laid out almost in an X pattern. The southernmost home of that cluster has a garage you can break into. Once you open the garage door, you'll see the white Ocelot Bloodless Jugular.
You'll need the key cloner to get in, which I assume you already have since you're doing jobs for Randy. No need to worry about the tracker , it's a standard one so it won't transmit your location to the cops. You still don't want to dawdle, because the owner of the car has a gun and he's not afraid to use it. He'll start shooting if he sees you boost the car.
Randy will pay you $10,615 for the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. He'll pay an extra $5,000 if you bring it to him in pristine condition.

pool.titulo: Studio founded by former Apex Legends leaders is closing without releasing a game
pool.resumen: Gravity Well, founded in 2020 as an "anti-crunch" game studio, lost its funding earlier this year and wasn't able to find a new backer.
pool.contenido:
Gravity Well, an "anti-crunch" studio founded in 2020 by former Apex Legends executive producer Drew McCoy and lead software engineer Jon Shiring, is entering "hibernation" after losing funding for its game.
Gravity Well's launch in 2020 came with high hopes. Founded by veterans of Call of Duty, Titanfall, and Apex Legends, it made the health of the team "an absolute top priority," McCoy said at the time.
"That means we are anti-crunch. That means good compensation. That means everyone at Gravity Well has creative freedom, because when someone else makes all of the decisions, work isn't fun and the end product isn't as good."
But like so many other ambitious new studios launched around that time, it fell victim to the post-pandemic retrenchment and has effectively shuttered without releasing a game. The shutdown comes just a month after the studio laid off more than 40 people in what it said was a "fight for survival" caused by the loss of funding. It also warned that "given the current state of the industry our future is uncertain."
A message now posted on the Gravity Well website (via RPS ) says the funding situation hasn't changed, and "sadly the time has come for Gravity Well to go into hibernation."
"We don’t exactly know what is next for us or Gravity Well, but we do know we still believe in the IP and game we were building," the message states. "Even moreso, the team we managed to cultivate was truly world class and we're going to miss getting to work with them every day. If you're a hiring manager or recruiter and a Gravity Well resume hits your desk they come with our highest recommendation."
The announcement concludes with an invitation to publishers and investors to reach out if they're interested in supporting the project.

pool.titulo: Nioh 3 Is Coming to XBOX in 2027
pool.resumen:
2025 marked the “Year of the Ninja” when the legendary Team NINJA development team released both Ninja Gaiden 2 Blackand Ninja Gaiden 4. Well, 2027 is poised to be the “Return of the Ninja” as for the first time ever, the Nioh series is making its debut on XBOX with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: […]
The post Nioh 3 Is Coming to XBOX in 2027 appeared first on XBOX Wire .
pool.contenido:
Summary Team NINJA and Koei Tecmo are bringing the Nioh series to XBOX for the first time ever with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition coming to XBOX Series X|S on January 28, 2027 . The Dark Samurai Action RPG explores a variety of locations and time periods of feudal Japan in an epic story that blends fantasy and history. Nioh 3 is Team NINJA at its peak with the kind of aggressive, mastery-focused combat that built their reputation with other action series, including NINJA GAIDEN , plus the ability to seamlessly switch between Nioh’s classic Samurai and brand-new Ninja Combat styles. As the culmination of Team NINJA’s years of experimentation and refinement of the Nioh series, and following the incredible response to Ninja Gaiden 4 , the studio felt that it was finally time to bring Nioh to XBOX.
2025 marked the “Year of the Ninja” when the legendary Team NINJA development team released both Ninja Gaiden 2 Black and Ninja Gaiden 4 . Well, 2027 is poised to be the “Return of the Ninja” as for the first time ever, the Nioh series is making its debut on XBOX with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition coming to XBOX Series X|S . The Complete Edition includes the full game and the two DLC expansions, which brings new story content, new bosses, new weapons, new abilities, endgame content, and more. For XBOX players, this is the perfect entry point into the series as it features the pinnacle of combat refinement you’ve come to know and expect from Team NINJA, as well as an open-field format that lets you explore and take on challenges at your own pace. No prior series knowledge is needed to understand the epic story that takes place across multiple eras of feudal Japan!
If you aren’t familiar with Nioh 3 , it’s Team NINJA’s take on the Age of the Samurai in Japan, as an open-field Dark Samurai Action RPG where you’re caught in a nefarious coup started right before you are appointed Shogun – the ruler of Japan. You play the role of Tokugawa Takechiyo, and just before taking the throne, your younger brother succumbs to his hatred and jealousy, and leads an army of Yokai (demonic spirits) to overthrow the natural order and take over Japan. Takechiyo survives thanks to the intervention of the Guardian Spirit Kusanagi, who lets you travel through time and experience battlefields across different eras and key locations.
In order to deal with the hordes of demonic Yokai, human rebels, and giant, grotesque bosses standing in your way of getting revenge on your younger brother and becoming the true Shogun of Japan, Takechiyo has some excellent tutelage in both Samurai and Ninja combat. In a series-first, you can switch seamlessly between the Samurai combat style and the new Ninja combat style: Samurai combat relies on specific weapon stances, which holds the keys to unlocking devastating combos, whereas Ninja combat relies on faster, fluid movements, aerial attacks, and elusiveness to chain together relentless attacks.
Takechiyo, as one would expect of a Shogun-to-be, can wield a series-high amount of weapons – from a variety of swords, bows, gunpowder weapons, axes, spears, fist weapons, and more. Weapons and armor provide increases for a wide variety of combat stats – with plenty of drops to sort through, finding the right weapon with the perfect stats to complement your play style is a key element of the Nioh series. Players also have access to Transformed Arts, Ninjutsu, Onmyo Magic and creatures summoned through Summoning Seals for you to perfect the ultimate combat style.
Team NINJA is in peak form with the combat of Nioh 3 , and XBOX players getting to experience it for the first time is a key reason why 2027 marks the Return of the Ninja. After years of the development team experimenting and tweaking the series formula for Nioh 3, and following the incredible Xbox fan reactions to Ninja Gaiden 4 on XBOX, the team felt it was the perfect moment to release the series on XBOX – just in time for the series’ 10 th anniversary. The Nioh 3: Complete Edition gives XBOX players access to the base game, but also the two DLC expansions, Hell Rising and Bloody Insurrection . Both DLC expansions add to the game’s story with new Eras and locations to explore, adding new equipment, combat abilities, skills, and much more. The DLC also adds several end-game level modes, such as the Battlefield of Carnage, which challenges you to take on 100 floors of battlefields overrun with enemies and bosses.
Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition will launch for the first time on XBOX Series X|S beginning January 28, 2027 – don’t miss out on the epic battle!

pool.titulo: Nvidia patch finally eradicates the SSD-hammering bug its last hotfix didn't actually fix
pool.resumen: "The evil is defeated."
pool.contenido:
Nvidia's latest GeForce Game Ready driver, version 621.40 , is out now. "This new Game Ready Driver provides the best gaming experience for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, and Assetto Corsa Rally," the notes say, "and the addition of DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering to Where Winds Meet."
Which is kind of burying the lead. This patch is really a hotfix for a hotfix, an update that finally addresses the bug with previous driver packages that had them pointlessly rewriting a log file over and over, quickly adding up to tens of GB every hour and potentially damaging SSDs nobody can afford to replace any more.
Over the weekend Nvidia released a hotfix that supposedly caught the bug, only for users to discover it merely delayed its onset . Rather than setting in immediately after a reboot, it would wait until your PC had been on for a while before shitting the bed. If you're one of the people who leaves your computer running overnight then I hope you stayed on version 621.01, the last safe driver package before the current one.
Forum users have been testing out version 621.40 and it seems to have not only stopped the Nvidia container service from freaking out and rewriting its log, but also caught a bug with custom cursors that would make them turn gray. Which is nice.
I'm tempted to play it safe and stay on my old driver anyway, though I'll update for Dawn of War 4, which comes out on December 3. People with the Commander Edition can jump in early on November 30, and readers in the US and UK can enter our competition to win a Steam code for the Commander Edition right now .

pool.titulo: The race to port GTA 6 to PC, explained
pool.resumen: GTA 6 could be a PC game (illegally) in a matter of days.
pool.contenido:
Things are moving fast. Now that an illicit Xbox build of GTA 6 is out in the wild, anonymous modders are racing to port it to PC, and the work is progressing faster than many expected. At this rate, it's possible that a static recompilation of GTA 6 will run on a PC in a matter of days. It's also possible it will take much longer to produce a playable build that's actually on par with the console versions.
What we do know for sure is that Rockstar is taking notice and has already begun cracking down on the highest-profile projects. As always, downloading pirated software is illegal and can infect your PC with malware, and that last bit is doubly true in the dubious AI era we now live in.
For now, the only thing to do is observe and report. Here's where things stand with GTA 6 PC ports.
Does GTA 6 currently run on PC? No.
Several projects have made it as far as booting the game and using menus, and at least one has seemingly managed to move around in-game with bugged out lighting , but it's hard to verify clips making the rounds when so many are obvious fakes .
Who is working on GTA 6 PC recomps? Dozens of groups of anonymous modders and vibecoders. So many, in fact, that several websites dedicated to tracking the progress of GTA 6 recomp efforts have also appeared. One of the tracker sites, Portwatch VI , has a list of projects ranked by their "playable" completion percentage—best not to take those made up figures as an accurate estimate of when a port will be complete. The top five are:
hyphennn VIctory XCL Xbox2Windows TuxBox Until very recently, the Leonida project was among those making impressive progress, but the group's creator (a 15-year-old) quit the project after Rockstar got its Discord server taken down.
How did we get here? Every GTA 6 recomp project is based on the same thing: An illicit Xbox build of GTA 6 released online by Cyberleek , the notorious leaker who previously shared video of a GTA 6 development build months before its release.
With GTA 6 being the biggest game in the world at the moment and not available on PC, there is an outsized motivation to get it running.
What is a recomp, and why is this possible so quickly? A recomp refers to static recompilation, which is the result of reverse-engineering a game's code to make it run on other hardware (usually a PC). If you want to read further on how that's achieved, PCG alum Wes Fenlon's excellent Read Only Memo newsletter has what you're looking for.
As for how GTA 6 ports (and ports for other new games) are coming together so quickly, the answer is AI. The advent of AI coding tools like Claude have greatly expedited the work required to create a static recompilation of games on another platform. What used to take months to years now takes hours to days. Recomps that heavily use AI are often buggier, messier, and have fewer features than human-made fan projects, but they are fast and functional.
Will a hypothetical GTA 6 PC recomp perform as well as an official PC port? It's way too early to speak in absolutes, but I'm comfortable assuming that the first "playable" recomps will require an exceptionally powerful PC.
That guess is based on GTA 6 being an obviously demanding game and also some recent precedent: The earliest Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake recomps that've appeared online have high system requirements to perform as well as it does natively on Switch 2—and, well, GTA 6 has a lot more happening under the hood than a 28-year-old Zelda game.
Is Rockstar gonna release the real PC port early in response? That's the big question. My money is on no, it won't. To switch up plans on a dime would assume that Rockstar is sitting on a polished PC version that it could put out any day, and I'm not convinced that's the case. The current rumor, preceding all of this leak business, is that the PC version of GTA 6 is planned for Q1 2027 (so anytime before April).
That's not to say Rockstar couldn't expedite the process if it wanted to—they certainly have the resources to achieve the unlikely.

pool.titulo: Fan-favorite Diablo 2 anniversary bosses and items won't disappear when Diablo 4's next season starts
pool.resumen: Most of the secrets from the current season aren't going anywhere.
pool.contenido:
According to every Diablo 4 player known to man, I screwed up by skipping its last season . Blizzard shoved just about every iconic Diablo 2 boss and item it could think of into the modern game, and, by all accounts, it was one of the best seasons it ever had.
Even though the Season of Hell's Legacy is about to come to an end, Blizzard has delivered good news for me and everyone else who missed it: Most of it will remain in the game permanently.
On December 1, when the Season of Tyrael's Gambit begins, all of the unique Prime Evil boss fights will still be available, along with the Diablo world boss, Moophisto, and a handful of Diablo 2-inspired items, including the Hellfire Torch Charm. However, the craftable items, like the Enigma chest piece that gives you a free teleport skill, will not carry over.
Even without all the craftable unique items, that's quite a lot of stuff to keep around. Blizzard tends to ditch seasonal additions as soon as a new season starts, and you usually have to wait a while to see them slipped back into the game in a slightly altered form. The overwhelming excitement around the Diablo 2 content must've convinced Blizzard it was worth putting in the work to keep them around.
I would've been happy if the portal to Tristram , the rickety old town at the center of Diablo 2, was all that came back. Blizzard pulled off an incredibly faithful remake of it, complete with the old guitar theme and the voice of the blacksmith Griswold. And if you follow the hidden steps to make the Hellfire Torch, you'll be able to visit Uber Tristram, a special version of the town where you can square off against all three of the series' major villains, the Prime Evils, at once.
Diablo 4 was always kind of light on hidden quests and bosses, so it's nice to see that Blizzard found a way to bring an important part of the series back. I'll be curious to see what else comes to the game over the next three years before Diablo 5 arrives. The Amazon class will drop next year, but no expansions are planned to fill the gap. Hopefully Blizzard will take this opportunity to experiment with more things like the Diablo 2 anniversary secrets before it moves onto the sequel.

pool.titulo: Marathon's new runner shell is a jet-propelled robot samurai who wants to hurt you
pool.resumen: Sounds great!
pool.contenido:
We're just a couple weeks away from Marathon's Symbiosis update , a hefty overhaul patch that's aiming to inject some juice into the shooter's live service appeal with the addition of PvE roguelite and Team Deathmatch modes, new weapons, and even a social hub for hanging out with fellow runners and testing guns at the firing range.
And that's all great. But today, Bungie dropped a new cinematic that presents its strongest argument for why Symbiosis should have our attention: You can play as a terrifying, sports-car scarlet robot samurai with a sword arm and jet legs.
While Bungie previously revealed Bishop, the new runner shell arriving with Symbiosis, in the update's first gameplay trailer earlier this month, the new cinematic provides a strong sense of the power fantasy it's trying to capture. By which I mean Bungie clearly wants you to feel like a nightmarish apex predator. Like a xenomorph if a xenomorph was bright red and had cool space guns.
As the trailer progresses, we watch as a team of runners is steadily cut down by a Bishop shell's unflinching onslaught: First, one of its members is culled after taking one of Bishop's throwable hacking knives to the neck, which seems to disrupt the target's functions. The next is blasted out of midair while trying to zipline away to safety. The third is hounded by autopistol fire into a position where they can be conveniently pounced on from above.
But the trailer's peak moment happens as the Bishop prepares to loot one of its kills and is winged by a bullet from a nearby Rook, who evidently hoped to clean up after watching the whole fight pan out. This is proven to be a mistake, because the Bishop settles into a crouch, extending a plasma-edged sword blade from between its knuckles and engaging the jet thrusters in its calves.
You know that thing in samurai movies where a swordsman does a lunging slash, leaving the body of his opponent to realize that it's been cut down behind him? It's like that. But with robots and jet propulsion. Marathon's going to have iaijutsu, is what I'm saying. Something for us all to look forward to.
Marathon's Symbiosis update lands on December 8.
